title: Ribbed Crown Sanctuary
description: Monumentale weiße Kalkstein-Rippenkrone (ca. 110 × 95 × 115 m) mit gestuftem Hufeisen-Sockel, neun asymmetrisch verjüngten gefasten Kalkstein-Rippen und zentralem gespaltenem Monolithen. Palette monument_white / stone_weathered / monument_shadow, 5 m Eingrabe-Fundament.

review.notes: Approved: 107x95x119m open scimitar rib crown on stepped horseshoe plinth (-5m skirt) and altar-grounded split spire match ref_08 and STYLE.md. Clean bevels, matte white/weathered limestone, dark inner spine contrast, dramatic scale vs 1.8m figure, 11.7k tris.
